summary: Closed the v11 run: package wiring, documentation with measured numbers, and the full non-browser sweep. (1) package.json (integrator-owned) gained exactly two lines, nothing pre-existing touched or renumbered — 'verify:area-toggles': 'node scripts/verify/area-toggles.mjs' and 'verify:view-filter-consistency': 'node scripts/verify/view-filter-consistency.mjs', placed after verify:division-toggles; npm run now lists 24 script entries (22 pre-existing + 2 new) and BOTH new lines were executed as npm scripts in the sweep, so the wiring is proven, not just written. (2) docs/SWARM_V11_PLAN.md (128 → 354 lines) gained section 7, the closure: 7.1 what shipped per item with files + the committed check that fails if it regresses (the two toggle rows, Reset/All bound to the existing applyViewPreset('brainstem-focus') and viewPresetOf(ALL_ON_LAYERS), the ONE visibility decision, the ONE cortical rule, the audit-side u/v convention, plus the coronal plane-frame defect this run found and fixed); 7.2 the measured numbers — (a) the AREA partition printed by verify:area-toggles: telencephalon 85 · diencephalon 39 · mesencephalon 25 (midbrain) · metencephalon 40 (pons 35 + cerebellum 5) · myelencephalon 33 (medulla) · vasculature 14 = 236 = every taxonomy entry over 7 regions each owned exactly once, boot row [true,true,true,true,true,false], metencephalon+myelencephalon = the rhombencephalon division exactly; (b) the SYSTEMS partition: nucleus 88 · tract 53 · ventricle 11 · surface 25 · vessel 14 · context 45 = 236 over ALL_KINDS; (c) per-case visibility agreement (verify:view-filter-consistency 100/100): 138 section parts × 4 states (on+on 138/138 painted, kind-off/area-off/both-off 138 hidden each), 0 of 138 parts with an undecidable region, 552 3D-vs-2D comparisons and 548 cross-surface joins with 0 disagreements, area off ⇒ every 3D pass hidden (213 structures / 23 tracts / 10 slots / 2 ghost shells, violations 0), cortical pass parity 5/5 planes with area off ⇒ 0 ribbons / 0 divisions, plus the execution proof (75 Path2D / 75 moveTo / 2233 lineTo / 75 closePath) and the bites; (d) the division-parity result (verify:cortical-lobes 564/564): per reference plane rule(l) ∥ rule(l+r), coverage 3 of 13 planes carry a right-ribbon-only division (y=0, y=14, y=58), the browser lane's 6 ARTEFACT_PLANES rows reconciled 6/6, floors read from source (10 au / 25 au² / 25 au² — the v10 plan's 10 au² is stale); (e) the plane-helper convention: AXIS_PAIR.x = [z,y] ⇒ u = 72−(−76) = 148, v = 116−(−55) = 171, so the shipped 148×171 quad is right and the audit's ascending-axis-name filter was the wrong side — the audit now reads the ORDERED table out of planeGeometry.ts (prints AXIS_PAIR {"y":["x","z"],"x":["z","y"],"z":["x","y"]} · AXIS_INDEX {"x":0,"y":1,"z":2}), hand-typed AXIS_INDEX deleted, verify:plane-helper-extent 206/0 lane A2 flipped to 'ascending-name in-plane derivation absent · reads AXIS_PAIR yes'. 7.3 what did NOT ship and why (preset row demoted to the shortcut row, not deleted, so the documented default framing stays reachable and asserted; the spec's stale 'canvas paints NONE' premise retired with numbers rather than re-fixed; the structure-level hidden-set axis measured and NOT unified; src/styles untouched (inline row styles); 137/138 cross-surface join with the 4 sub-region parts and ctx-pineal named; verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit red for environment only; no content moved). 7.4 the 14 verify:audit failures from v10 (202 passed / 14 failed) re-stated class by class: (a) item-1 convention fixed on the audit side; (a′) the helper-group read hardened with named failures and NO claim the v10 throw is gone; (b) item-4 divergence retired as a one-ribbon coverage artefact with per-plane numbers; (c) the v10 hygiene shape reading unchanged by v11 and explicitly left orchestrator-only; no check deleted (the one re-purposing is the PLAN §3b-mandated ARTEFACT_PLANES printed cross-check). 7.5 claim tiers (non-browser-asserted vs orchestrator-browser-only) and 7.6 the integrator sweep with every exit code. (3) README.md (+184/−4): two new Features bullets and a new '## v11 — the Areas + Systems toggle rows replace the view-preset row' section — the two rows with the Areas/Systems tables, an explicit 'what changed for users' paragraph (the preset row MOVED to a shortcut row beneath Areas/Systems, Reset/All, the default framing unchanged), the one-visibility-decision table, the two carry-over results with the per-plane and arithmetic tables, the coronal fix, a v11 honest-limits table (the area grouping is a display grouping over the taxonomy regions; the systems axis IS the kind axis ALL_KINDS, with the 25-surface/17-body/0-part and 26-vessel-part notes; the cortical division is fitted to the DERIVED ribbon, not a gyral map — no fitted constant changed; the claim tier), and the close-out verification table; also the tier-1 binding list, the must-exit-0 list, the Scripts table (two new gate rows), the Content-scope note (v10 and v11 added no content) and the sandbox-red paragraph (both reds re-measured identical). (4) docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md (+81 lines, new §14): measured delta (validate identical to v10: 236/213/23/26/15/17, 0 errors), the content-shaped partition tables with per-region registry-row counts, the systems axis table, and the content-shaped limits (25 surface records / 17 with a 3D body / 0 section parts; 26 vessel parts gated by taxonomyKind while their draw bucket is nucleus; 4 sub-region parts + ctx-pineal; the hidden-set axis), plus its own verification table. RED, reported not papered over: verify:anatomy exit 1 (spawnSync powershell EPERM, before any verdict — environmental, red at base, in no v11 write scope) and verify:imaging-fit exit 1 (spawnSync node EPERM, 0 assertions run — same). Writes stayed inside the exclusive scope (README.md, docs/CONTENT_INVENTORY.md, docs/SWARM_V11_PLAN.md, package.json — git status confirms), plus this report.
